metadata.question: Are more brown/orange areas visible in the Adirondack Mountains on October 8, 2022, than on October 1, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Adirondack Mountains, New York State - Date: Two specific dates - October 1, 2022 and October 8, 2022 - Collection: Sentinel-2 (10m resolution) for visual assessment, or Landsat 8/9 as fallback - Need to capture fall foliage color change (brown/orange = senescent vegetation) 2. Masking strategy: - Must mask clouds since we're looking at visible colors - The question is about brown/orange areas, not clouds - Use SCL band for Sentinel-2 or QA_PIXEL for Landsat 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Brown/orange areas can be detected using indices or RGB band ratios - Approach: Calculate a "brownness" or "senescence" index - One method: High Red, lower NIR (compared to green vegetation), low Blue - Another: Use (Red + SWIR) / NIR or similar combinations - Need to ensure we have valid pixels after cloud masking - Valid Zero (B) = legitimately less brown/orange on Oct 8 - C2 = No valid pixels after masking - C3 = Calculation returns None/NaN ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Adirondack Mountains region const adirondacks = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-74.8, 43.2], [-73.3, 43.2], [-73.3, 44.3], [-74.8, 44.3], [-74.8, 43.2]] ]); // 2. Define dates const date1 = '2022-10-01'; const date2 = '2022-10-08'; // 3. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const scl = image.select('SCL'); const mask = scl.neq(3).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 4. Function to calculate brown/orange index (senescence) // Brown/orange = high Red, moderate Green, lower NIR relative to summer function calculateBrownness(image) { const red = image.select('B4'); const nir = image.select('B8'); const swir = image.select('B11'); // Senescence index: (Red + SWIR) / (NIR + 0.1) - higher values = more brown/orange const brownIndex = red.add(swir).divide(nir.add(0.1)); return brownIndex.rename('brown_index'); } // 5. Get Sentinel-2 data for Oct 1 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(adirondacks) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Oct 1 Images: ${size1}`); if (size1 === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 data for Oct 1, trying Landsat 9'); col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(adirondacks) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')); if (col1.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // 6. Get Sentinel-2 data for Oct 8 let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(adirondacks) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Oct 8 Images: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 data for Oct 8, trying Landsat 9'); col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(adirondacks) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')); if (col2.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // 7. Process images const img1 = maskS2clouds(col1.median()); const img2 = maskS2clouds(col2.median()); const brown1 = calculateBrownness(img1); const brown2 = calculateBrownness(img2); // 8. Calculate statistics const stats1 = brown1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: adirondacks, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = brown2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: adirondacks, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean1 = stats1.get('brown_index_mean').getInfo(); const count1 = stats1.get('brown_index_count').getInfo(); const mean2 = stats2.get('brown_index_mean').getInfo(); const count2 = stats2.get('brown_index_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Oct 1 - Brownness: ${mean1}, Valid Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`Oct 8 - Brownness: ${mean2}, Valid Pixels: ${count2}`); // 9. Validation if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // 10. Final comparison if (mean2 > mean1) { console.log('More brown/orange on Oct 8 than Oct 1'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Not more brown/orange on Oct 8 than Oct 1'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
